title: Web Development Is Not the Safe Bet Anymore
description:
Learn JS, learn React, get a job — that worked in 2021, not 2026. The real question isn't whether to learn web dev, it's what layer of the stack you're on. The closer to the layer AI depends on, the stronger your career. Full comparison on the channel.

#WebDevelopment #JavaScript #React #AIjobs #TechCareers
